dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (日医標準レセプトソフト); uses GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL conventions with COPY/REPLACING using // delimiters, LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM, EXIT PROGRAM, and MCP-style subprogram calls
evidence: LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM PIC X(256)
EXIT PROGRAM vs STOP RUN conditional

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical receipt (レセプト) processing system - JMA ORCA standard receipt software; this program consolidates/aggregates same-item receipt entries (同一剤のまとめ) across RECE62/RECE64/RECE65 indexed files
purpose.summary: ORCR0655 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that consolidates duplicate or same-item (同一剤) receipt line entries. It reads from indexed receipt files (RECE62, RECE64, RECE65), aggregates matching records into a work file (RECE642), then outputs the reorganized data to RECE64W. It supports realtime preview, cancellation handling, and public-expense separation (公費単独レセ分離).

notable_features: 19 COPY statements with REPLACING using // delimiter syntax
Multiple indexed files with DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access modes on same physical file (RECE642/RECE642X, RECE64W/RECE64WX)
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM for shell invocation
Conditional EXIT PROGRAM vs STOP RUN based on SHELLID
UNSTRING for parsing comma-delimited command parameters
Japanese EUC-encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - file-based indexed I/O only
OCCURS clauses for comment and index work areas
verdict.notes: Comments are in Japanese EUC encoding, decoded as latin-1 producing mojibake. File is part of the open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system, a well-known Japanese healthcare IT platform. Source truncated at 16000 chars out of 39162 bytes; full procedure division not visible but structure is clear. Long lines slightly over 72 chars (8 lines) consistent with fixed format with minor overrun.
